title: Tooling: 6.47× faster production R420 mutants geometry cache with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, production `research/e8-bit-r420/code/mutants.py` still rebuilt full geometry for every gate-only mutation control. The opt-in adapter `research/r420-geometry-cache/` already proved geometry reuse with identical mutation receipts. This PR wires that equivalent cache into the **production** harness used by `verify.sh`: gate-only controls keep identical geometry fields; `Word.__init__`/`labels()` are cached; `full()`/`interface()` always rerun. `research/e8-bit-r420/MANIFEST.sha256` binds the new digest.

No certificate κ pins change. The pairwise-era `mutants.py` digest in `research/r420-geometry-cache/SOURCES.json` is moved to `provenance_inputs` so research-packages CI does not fail working-source drift. Leave [#2263](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2263) `xcheck.rref` alone (this tip does not edit `xcheck.py`). Both PRs update `MANIFEST.sha256` for different file digests — expect a trivial manifest merge if both land.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3, five alternating fresh-process pairs gave median mutants-harness wall time **9.602 → 1.485 s (6.47×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Mutation stdout digest stays `8c2738b3258e…`; JSON receipts match the baseline harness.

Package: `research/r420-geometry-cache-production/`.
Tip: `feb0b96b5c471be0a8c72e6ecb8f9e1f74b48991`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/r420-geometry-cache-production/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/r420-geometry-cache-production/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r420-geometry-cache-production
python3.12 -I -B research/r420-geometry-cache-production/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_R420_GEOMETRY_CACHE_PRODUCTION controls=10 corruption=subprocess_failure mutants_sha=8c2738b3258e certs=0 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/r420-geometry-cache-production outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_R420_GEOMETRY_CACHE_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Temp-copy stale-`full` foil rejects via subprocess failure. Package gates under `-O` still launch assertion-enabled children. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated harness change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different delivery): `research/r420-geometry-cache/` (opt-in geometry reuse; this is the production wiring), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2257) / [#2263](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2263) (same production-promotion + provenance pattern). No competing open PR on production `mutants.py` geometry reuse at refresh.

Credit the authors of `research/r420-geometry-cache/` and **eumemic** (PR543 harness/checker). Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
